entry.title: Watch Tuner Lite
entry.content:
优惠信息（价格：¥15.00 → ¥8.00 [¥8.00 ~ ¥15.00]）

全部价格信息

价格：¥8.00

应用描述

Watch Tuner Lite measures the accuracy of mechanical and automatic watches. It uses the built-in microphone or headset microphone to record the audible tick of the watch and calculates the seconds-per-day deviation. Works with almost any 'ticking' watch/clock. Use in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect the accuracy of the results. Complete silence is best. Recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset microphone. You will get the best results using original Apple EarPods. This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation. If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you. If you prefer to measure also beat error and amplitude, try Watch Tuner - a bigger brother of this app. If you need frequency diagram look at Watch Tuner Timegrapher - the most sophisticated app of Watch Tuner series.

应用描述

432 Player plays the music you already own, retuned live from A = 440 Hz to A = 432 Hz. Nothing is converted or copied in advance: press play and hear your own songs in 432. YOUR MUSIC, RETUNED AS IT PLAYS • 432 Hz, or 528 mode (A = 444 Hz), switched while the song is playing • Two ways to retune: Pitch shift keeps the song's speed; Song speed lowers pitch and tempo together, like a turntable • Hold Compare to hear the original tuning and decide for yourself • A test tone, so you can check the tuning with any tuner A REAL MUSIC PLAYER • Your Music library, the Files app, iCloud Drive and folders you link • MP3, AAC, M4A, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and more • 10-band equalizer with presets and your own settings • Playlists, Up Next, shuffle, repeat and search • Lyrics from the song file or a matching .lrc file, in time with the retuned song • Sleep timer, AirPlay, lock screen and headphone controls • Designed for iPhone and iPad INCLUDED: THE ALBUM DREAMWORLD Twelve tracks by Ophir Paz come with the app, so there is something to play from the first minute. You can hide the album in Settings if you want only your own music. FREE TO USE Every feature is included for free. Free listening gives you 18 minutes of 432 or 528 Hz at a time. Then the tuning rests for one hour, and your music keeps playing at its original pitch. 432 PLAYER PRO Pro removes the limit. One membership also unlocks 432 Player Radio, on iPhone and iPad. ALREADY BOUGHT 432 PLAYER? If you bought 432 Player before version 6, you keep full access for life. There is nothing you need to do. GOOD TO KNOW • Songs from an Apple Music subscription are protected and can't be retuned. Songs you own, bought or imported, play in 432. • Most recorded music is tuned to A = 440 Hz, and that is what the app assumes. • No account and no sign-in. Your music stays on your device. PRIVACY The app collects anonymous usage data and crash reports to help improve it. They are never linked to you and never used for advertising, and you can switch them off in Settings. SUBSCRIPTIONS 432 Player Pro is offered as a monthly or a yearly subscription, and to new listeners as a one-time lifetime purchase for a limited time. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
